title: Juicy Grilled Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and healthy Mediterranean dish featuring lamb kebabs with a sweet and tangy glaze, perfect for a quick dinner or meal prep, this recipe is shojin-friendly and does not include any animal products except for the lamb, the ketchup used is a special shojin-friendly version.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, ketchup, garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Brush the kebabs with the remaining marinade during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh bay leaves and serve hot.
